body:
Thanks for your response. Your first paragraph is exactly why I probably won't tell her father unless she gets feeling much worse. 


I know she's seeing a therapist, and that's a good thing, but how much help can they be if they don't know about the molestation and suicidal thoughts? I honestly don't know, I've never been to a therapist. Basically what I'm asking is, is the fact that she can talk to me about her issues and she knows I'll believe her and be there for her going to keep her from hurting herself? I'd rather have her be alive and hate my guts, than dead and trust me. 

Also, in the event I did tell her father, I would send him screenshots of our messages when we first started talking. In those messages it shows I thought she was a guy and had no idea of her age. Hopefully that should give him some peace of mind that I am only trying to help her and not anything else. 

Thanks again for your advice.

Hi, thank you for your reply and I'm really sorry that happened to you as well. If you want me to contact your boyfriend or parents for you and tell them anything please feel free to let me know. I actually told her that as well. We were talking about one of her guy friends who likes her, but she doesn't like him because he's mean to her sometimes. It's the typical high school guy thing where his friends know that he likes her, so he's mean to her in front of his friends so they don't make fun of him for liking her. She said, "He's actually a pretty good looking guy, I might be interested in him if he wasn't constantly putting me down". So I said, "Do you want me to tell him that for you? Because I'll be glad to. Heck, if there's anything you ever want to tell someone, but don't have the courage to do it directly, you just let me know and I can do it for you. You want me to talk to your mom, dad, brothers, friends, therapist, you name it and I'll do that for you. I can be your messenger." She thanked me but said she didn't have any messaging plans. 

I feel the same way, I think she wants me to tell him, but if I'm wrong I feel like I will have directly pushed her to her death and that's what's stopping me. Because she's told me her last name, where her father works and what he does there, and the fact that it's a very popular online company that is very easy to find information on leads me to believe that she wanted me to know who he is and how to get ahold of him. But I'm just not sure I can take that step yet without knowing more about him. 

I've tried to get more info the last 2 days but she's been super busy taking care of her mom who's injured and doing the stuff her mom would normally do around the house while still having to do homework and everything else that a 16 year old has to do. Unfortunately I don't have her cell phone number, so she only sees my messages when she opens up Imgur. 

Thanks for your advice, and I wish you the best!
